text:
Which statement about ethane is correct?
A
It decolourises bromine water.
B
It burns in excess oxygen to form water and carbon dioxide.
C
Its molecular formula is C2H4.
D
Its atoms are joined together by ionic bonding.

options.label: B
options.text: It burns in excess oxygen to form water and carbon dioxide.

options.label: D
options.text: Its atoms are joined together by ionic bonding.
